title: Fix the bearer-token check in front of the orders API
acceptanceCriteria: A valid `HS256` token with the required scope is accepted, with `userId` from `sub`
No credentials → `401` with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="api"` and no error code
A token that isn't a correctly signed `HS256` token — edited payload, wrong secret, `alg: none`, malformed — gets `401` with `error="invalid_token"`
A token is rejected from its `exp` second on (`exp` is in seconds), and a token with no `exp` is rejected
A valid token without the required scope gets `403` with `error="insufficient_scope", scope="…"`
